$schema-note: Recorded exceptions to the fresh-release quarantine (bunfig.toml install.minimumReleaseAge, enforced on lockfiles by scripts/release-age-gate.mjs). A lockfile entry published less than the quarantine ago is allowed ONLY by an entry here, so the gate can never be silently bypassed (an install with --minimum-release-age 0 still has to land its result in a lockfile, where this check sees it). Each entry names ONE ecosystem (npm, crates, go), ONE exact package and ONE exact version, and MUST carry: `justification` (at least 20 characters: why it cannot wait, e.g. a security fix, and that the diff was read), `added` (ISO date) and `expires` (ISO date, required, at most 14 days after `added`: a fresh release stops being fresh within days, so an exception never needs to outlive the quarantine by much). Wildcards, ranges and unknown keys are rejected. Prefer waiting.
